36 inch Iron Art Dummy Strap Heart Tip Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn IHPBP, 36" Iron Art Dummy Strap Heart Tip Hinge

The 36 Inch Heart Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge are for use with butt hinges. Dummy Heart Tip Strap Hinges give an old world charm to any home door without the need of installing working hinges. This makes them especially good for use on places where installing working hinges to get the same look would be impractical, such as on a garage door. Made from hand forged iron art using the techniques of the traditional forge they have a lifetime no-rust warranty.

Also Available Matching:
14" Heart Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge
20" Heart Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge
30" Heart Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications and Features of the Heart Tip Iron Art Dummy Hinge:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 36"
  • Strap Width: 3"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
